title: Dronagiri: Hanuman's mountain at real scale
caption:
Legend says Hanuman tore the top off this mountain and flew it across India 🏔️

📖 In Valmiki's Ramayana, Lakshmana is wounded in the war at Lanka. Only Himalayan herbs can save him. Hanuman can't tell the herbs apart, so he brings the whole peak.
📍 Tradition names it Dronagiri, Uttarakhand, over 7,000 m tall.
⚖️ Its top 1 km alone ≈ 2.8 billion tonnes (our estimate), more than 5× the weight of every human on Earth.
✈️ About 2,300 km to Lanka in one night: around 230 km/h.
🏘️ Many in Dronagiri village still don't worship Hanuman.

Follow for more legends, at real scale.
